differences_remaining: regimes must hold exactly two (pH, E) panels; R-cell is a one-dimensional window vs Li+/Li (schema v2 stability.R-cell). W6 needs a window panel that reads stability.R-cell.windows, as W4.2 states.

domains[].phase allows solid and aqueous only; equilibrium domains are mixtures (schema v2 domain_identity kind: solid | aqueous | gas | mixed). The export writes the v2 kind, so mixed domains fail W6's enum.
domains[].species is one joined label; schema v2 carries a component list (domain_identity.components). The export keeps the joined label and adds nothing W6 rejects.
potential_range has no reference electrode; schema v2 fixes SHE for R-slurry and Li+/Li for R-cell.
no field for decomposition energies, design axes (a_Ca, C_T), the ACC dissolution margin or the falsifiability control; schema v2 holds the first in decomposition_energy and W5's summary the rest.

W6 has no place for the design axes: one figure panel is one design point. Schema v2 also has one state per document, so W5 writes one document per design point (results/preprint/pourbaix/final/slurry/).
